title: Ethereum blob limit bumps up to 21, boosting network scalability
summary: Ethereum developers have raised the blob limit for a second time in recent weeks, a move that will allow more transactions to be batched via rollups, making them cheaper.

title: Quantum threat to Bitcoin extends past wallet hacks: Coinbase analyst
summary: Cypherpunk Adam Back has frequently shot down claims that quantum computing will be a threat to Bitcoin anytime soon.

title: Bitcoin ETFs come into year 'like a lion’: 600% surge at current pace
summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs attracted over $1.2 billion in the first two trading days of 2026, with analysts projecting annual inflows could reach $150 billion.

title: CLARITY Act headed for markup next week: Senator Tim Scott
summary: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act aims to establish a comprehensive framework for crypto market structure in the United States.

title: US community banks join campaign to shut a GENIUS Act ‘loophole’
summary: The Community Bankers Council has asked the Senate for a crypto market structure bill that will ban exchanges and others offering interest on stablecoins.

title: Bitchat dev shrugs off Uganda’s threat to block app: ‘Good luck mate’
summary: Bitchat developer Calle boldly said, “You can’t stop us” after Uganda threatened to block Bitchat ahead of elections next week.

title: Flow details December exploit that led to $3.9M in losses due to counterfeit tokens
summary: A protocol-level flaw allowed assets to be duplicated rather than minted, prompting a network halt and a governance-led recovery process.

title: Win for Strategy: MSCI keeps crypto treasury companies in indexes
summary: MSCI announced it will keep digital asset treasury companies in its global indexes, citing investor feedback and the need for further study on non-operating firms.

title: Bitcoin miner using compute heat to supplement Canadian greenhouses
summary: Canaan‘s pilot program will use the miner‘s liquid cooling systems to supplement the power needed to heat intake water for greenhouses, helping grow tomatoes.

title: Jupiter launches JupUSD stablecoin backed by BlackRock’s BUIDL fund
summary: The Solana-native token is backed by USDtb and USDC and is designed to serve as a settlement asset across Jupiter’s DeFi stack.
